_comment: Runs judge-jev after each tool use. Set JUDGE_JEV_INPUT to the trajectory JSON
itself (not a path) -- the hook pipes it straight to `--input -`, so there is
no temp file to write or clean up.
This runs live by default (TYPESAFE_API_KEY required), because a hook whose
job is to gate real work must not judge canned answers. Add --mock only to
smoke-test the wiring; a mocked judgment must never be treated as a real
Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 review, 3 escalate, 4 skip, 10/11 operational
This template blocks only on escalate (3) and lets every other outcome through;
drop the `case` to block on fail as well. Do not add `|| true`: that discards
the verdict and makes the hook decorative.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; printf %s "$JUDGE_JEV_INPUT" | "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/judge-jev" run --rubric agent-trajectory --input -; code=$?; case $code in 3) echo "judge-jev: escalated for human review" >&2; exit 2 ;; 10|11) echo "judge-jev: could not judge (exit $code)" >&2; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac'
